definitions.explanation: A school uniform modeled on naval sailor suits, traditionally worn by female middle and high school students in Japan. Features a characteristic sailor collar.

examples.japanese: セーラー{服|ふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{女子|じょし}{高生|こうせい}→女子高生：12381_joshikousei⟧。
examples.english: A high school girl wearing a sailor uniform.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧セーラー{服|ふく}だった。
examples.english: My middle school's uniform was a sailor uniform.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧セーラー{服|ふく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ブレザー→ブレザー：28533_burezaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more and more schools are switching from sailor uniforms to blazers.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
セーラー{服|ふく} has been a standard school uniform style in Japan since the early 20th century. While historically very common, many schools have been transitioning to ⟦ブレザー→ブレザー：28533_burezaa⟧ (blazer) style uniforms. The sailor uniform remains an iconic symbol of Japanese school life.

ETYMOLOGY:
セーラー (sailor) + ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (clothing). The design originates from European naval uniforms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- セーラー{服|ふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧: a school with sailor uniforms
- ⟦{夏服|なつふく}→夏服：23421_natsufuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧セーラー{服|ふく}: summer sailor uniform
- ⟦{冬服|ふゆふく}→冬服：23084_fuyufuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧セーラー{服|ふく}: winter sailor uniform
